findings.text: During a 12-second window with no user interaction, the page made 430 requests to 118 third-party domains (median of 3 passes).
Of 67.3 MB transferred in that window (compressed responses that finished loading), 6.9 MB (10%) came from third-party domains, 1.8 MB of it from services classified as tracking (271 requests).

62 third-party services classified as advertising, analytics, social or audience measurement were contacted before any interaction: 1rx.io (RhythmOne (Magnite), advertising), 33across.com (33Across, advertising), 3lift.com (TripleLift, advertising), acuityplatform.com (Acuity Ads, advertising), adform.net (Adform, advertising), adnxs.com (Microsoft (Xandr), advertising), ads-twitter.com (X, advertising), ads.linkedin.com (LinkedIn, advertising), adsrvr.org (The Trade Desk, advertising), adtrafficquality.google (Google, advertising).
195 cookies were set by third-party domains (254 cookies in total).
